concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-shopper-engagement-shopper-input-rating]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen Docs GetRating terminal InputRequest for Device/Input fields, prompt UI, unvalidated `DigitInput`, timeout, override and Cancel response branches.
warnings: 0–10 is the guide's intended range, but format/range validation is delegated to the merchant; the example labels only 0–9.
An input response is not a payment, consent or identity result; timeout and terminal Cancel share Cancel error condition but have different context.
